test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The __sporadic__ instructions of the invigilators distracted the examinee.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Occasional**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Sporadic **means not happening or appearing in a pattern; not continuous or regular. (एक पैटर्न में नहीं हो रहा है या दिखाई नहीं दे रहा है; निरंतर या नियमित नहीं)

 
 
• Example -* She makes sporadic trips to Europe.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Occasional **means occurring, appearing, or done infrequently and irregularly. (घटित होना, प्रकट होना, या बार-बार और अनियमित रूप से किया जाना)
 
 
• Example -* I play the occasional game of tennis.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Sporadic**' and '**Occasional**' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Continuous**: Uninterrupted extension in space or time or sequence. (अंतरिक्ष या समय या अनुक्रम में निर्बाध विस्तार)
 
• **Indirect**: Not directly caused by or resulting from something. (किसी चीज से सीधे या उसके परिणामस्वरूप नहीं)
 
• **Repetitive**: Containing or characterized by repetition, especially when unnecessary or tiresome. (दोहराव से युक्त या विशेषता, विशेषकर जब अनावश्यक या थकाऊ हो)
